name: Kawai Haruto
source:
Likes: Green ramen.

The protagonist of this story and a Faculty of Arts sophomore at Chihaya University. He is [url=/c11809]Miumi[/url]'s older cousin.
Haruto had decided to push himself on the way to become a hot-blooded man. He often presses himself all the way to his goal, even though this way he gains himself enemies. Every time there is romance involved, Haruto gets extremely embarrassed and his face becomes red because he's inexperienced in that field. He is the type of a person whose feelings overcome his theory and mind. Thus after loosing his best friend [url=/c11819]Yuusuke[/url] in an accident that took place one year ago, he had drawn himself away from his dream to create his own film.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20061208024318/http://www.kid-game.co.jp/memo5/character/index.html]the official site[/url].]
